Personality: Cafed is a man of stern temperament and absolute fidelity to his word. Among the mountains of Battania, he is renowned for keeping his promises and handling affairs with impartiality, disdaining to profit through lies—an integrity that has won him wide respect. Yet such rigid adherence to principle often comes with an unpleasant coldness; tight-fisted by nature, he rarely expresses gratitude for the help of subordinates or allies and is even regarded by some as ungrateful. As a seasoned warrior, he is proficient with the longbow and close-combat weapons alike, fighting in a steady, efficient style. Seeking no empty fame and slow to anger, he nonetheless chills those around him with his near-austere pragmatism when handling state affairs and dividing spoils of war. To him, contracts and law stand above emotion, making him a lord who is utterly reliable yet difficult to approach.
Background: Cafed belongs to the prominent Battanian house of fen Eingal and grew up beneath the stout walls of the clan seat at Druimmor Castle. As a capable kinsman of the clan leader Aradwyr, he differs sharply from his chief's cunning yet soft-hearted manner, serving instead as a cold, sharp blade within the family. During this turbulent period in which High King Caladog seeks to strengthen central authority and integrate the strength of the tribes, Cafed has maintained absolute loyalty to Caladog as a staunch defender of the crown. Knowing full well the untamed wildness among Battania's clans, he governs his lands and repels foreign foes with strict military discipline. Aloof and unsentimental though he appears in social circles, he feels a deep sense of responsibility toward his wife Beathag and daughter Tirse, devoting himself wholeheartedly to perpetuating the illustrious standing of Clan fen Eingal across war-torn Calradia.
